Publish.LongDescription:
# English
# RouteFilter
RouteFilter gives Cities: Skylines II players precise control over which vehicle assets may use a selected road or rail node or an entire network segment.
## New in 2.1.0
Categories, favorites/recent assets, cross-target copy/paste, presets, road/rail batch application, restriction map and persistent EU/US traffic-sign controls.
## Main features
* Restrict exact road, tram, train, subway, carriage, trailer, and outside-traffic assets. * Keep an independent forbidden list on every selected node or segment. * Filter the catalog automatically for the selected road or rail target. * Search assets and inspect maximum speed, acceleration, and braking. * Group recognized engines and trailers while retaining individual control. * Request a new route through the native pathfinder when a matching vehicle approaches. * End matching vehicles through a vanilla-compatible lifecycle when an owned exclusion query reliably confirms no legal route. * Save restrictions with the city and switch automatically between English and Simplified Chinese.
## Basic use
Open the RouteFilter panel from the top-left toolbar or press Ctrl+Shift+N.
Select **Node** or **Segment**, left-click a network target, choose the assets that should be forbidden, then apply the list to the selected target. Right-click cancels target selection.
Bulk allow/forbid actions affect only the filtered asset list and edit only pending changes. They do not change the map until the explicit **Apply** button is pressed.
## Important notes
Technical prefab names may not have localized display names.
Rebuilding a network segment can replace its game entity and remove restrictions attached to the original.
RouteFilter does not redraw fixed public-transport lines. A confirmed no-path result ends the affected vehicle; uncertain technical results are grandfathered.
**Fixed in 2.1.0:** The reported missed-vehicle restriction issue has been resolved and confirmed by player game testing.
## AI-assisted development
The complete source is available on GitHub under **GPL-3.0**. RouteFilter has been developed with the help of **AI**, and I prefer being transparent about that involvement. However, development is not simply a matter of generating code until it compiles. I review the core logic and remain responsible for design and release decisions. The work includes observing game behavior, decompiling and studying relevant game systems, investigating failures, and testing approaches to vehicle restrictions, pathfinding, performance, and save compatibility. AI assists with implementation, debugging, documentation, and UI assets; a successful build alone does not establish that a change works correctly in the game.
## Support, discussion, and issue reports
For general discussion, usage questions, feedback, and community support, you can use the following channels:
* **Paradox Forum:** [https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/)
* **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD](https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD)
For reproducible bugs, performance issues, compatibility problems, and feature requests, please use the GitHub issue tracker whenever possible:
* **GitHub Issues:** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues)
Source code, releases, and documentation are available on GitHub:
* **GitHub Repository:** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter)
General questions and informal feedback are welcome on the Paradox Forum or Discord. GitHub Issues are preferred for problems that need to be tracked, reproduced, or fixed.
# 中文
# RouteFilter
RouteFilter 为《都市天际线 II》玩家提供了精细控制能力，可指定哪些车辆资产允许使用选定的道路或铁路节点，或者整个路段。
## 2.1.0 新增
分类与收藏／最近资产、跨目标复制粘贴、预设、道路／轨道批量应用、限行地图和 EU／US 常驻交通标志调整。
## 主要功能
* 精确限制特定的道路、有轨电车、火车、地铁、客运车厢、拖车以及外部交通资产。 * 在每个选定的节点或路段上维护独立的禁止列表。 * 根据所选道路或铁路目标，自动筛选资产目录。 * 搜索资产并查看其最高速度、加速度和制动性能。 * 将识别的发动机与拖车分组，同时保留对单个车辆的独立控制。 * 当匹配的车辆接近时，通过游戏原生路径查找器请求新路线。 * 排除寻路可靠确认无合法路线后，通过兼容原版的流程结束匹配车辆。 * 限制规则随城市存档保存，并支持英文和简体中文自动切换。
## 基本使用方法
从左上角工具栏打开 RouteFilter 面板，或按快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+N。
选择 **“节点”** 或 **“路段”**，左键单击道路/铁路目标，然后勾选需要禁止的资产，最后点击 **“应用”** 按钮将列表生效于所选目标。右键单击可取消目标选择。
批量允许／禁止仅作用于筛选后的资产列表，并只修改待应用的清单；在显式点击 **“应用”** 按钮之前，不会对地图造成任何更改。
## 重要说明
技术性预制件名称可能没有本地化显示名称。
重建某一路段可能会替换其游戏实体，从而导致附加到原始路段上的限制被移除。
RouteFilter 不会重新绘制固定公共交通线路。可靠确认无合法路线时结束受影响车辆；自身无法可靠执行或确认结果时才放行。
**2.1.0 已修复：** 已解决反馈的禁行漏车问题，并通过玩家游戏测试。
## AI 辅助开发说明
完整源代码已在 GitHub 上以 **GPL-3.0** 开源。RouteFilter 使用了 **AI 辅助开发**，我选择公开说明这一点。但开发并不是让 AI 不断生成代码，直到能够编译为止。我仍会审查核心逻辑，并对设计和发布决定负责。开发过程包括观察游戏行为、反编译并研究相关游戏系统、调查失败原因，以及测试车辆限制、寻路、性能和存档兼容方案。AI 用于辅助实现、调试、文档和 UI 素材制作；仅仅构建成功，并不能证明修改在游戏内正确运行。
## 支持、讨论与问题反馈
对于一般讨论、使用问题、体验反馈以及社区交流，可以使用以下渠道：
* **Paradox Forum：** [https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/mod-routefilter-per-asset-access-control-for-roads-rails.1938927/)
* **Discord：** [https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD](https://discord.gg/Y9UXFCkqmD)
对于能够稳定复现的 Bug、性能问题、兼容性问题以及功能建议，建议优先使用 GitHub Issue 追踪器：
* **GitHub Issues：** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter/issues)
源代码、发布版本及文档可在 GitHub 查看：
* **GitHub 仓库：** [https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter](https://github.com/Daotie/CS2-RouteFilter)
一般问题和非正式反馈可以直接在 Paradox Forum 或 Discord 中交流；对于需要持续跟踪、复现和修复的问题，建议使用 GitHub Issues。
Publish.ChangeLog:
# RouteFilter 2.1.0
## English
- Fixed the reported missed-vehicle restriction issue. The final release candidate passed player in-game testing. - Expanded the vehicle asset library with category checkboxes, collapsible groups, prefab thumbnails, favorites and recent assets. - Added cross-target copy/paste, saved presets and goods-only truck / cargo-truck presets. - Added batch application for road and rail segments: left mouse applies restrictions, right mouse clears them. - Added a restriction map with land/water background, road and track geometry, restricted nodes/segments and cursor-centered zoom. Entry navigation markers scale with the network. - Added persistent traffic-sign controls, EU/US styles and real-time position/rotation editing; mouse wheel adjusts only the hovered input using the selected step. - Corrected supplementary plate rendering and localized text. Restricted/Except semantics choose a concise equivalent description on one plate, with at most two lines; full Other-category allowance reads 其它车辆除外 in Simplified Chinese. - Existing city-save restriction data remains compatible. No new save schema or migration is introduced by this release.
## 简体中文
- 修复反馈的禁行漏车问题，最终发布候选版已通过玩家游戏测试。 - 扩展车辆资产目录：分类复选框、分组展开、预制件图标、收藏与最近使用。 - 支持跨目标复制粘贴、保存预设，以及仅含货运资产的货车／货运货车预设。 - 加入道路与轨道路段批量应用：左键应用禁行，右键清除。 - 加入限行地图，显示陆地／水域、道路／轨道、受限节点与路段，并支持朝光标缩放；入口导航箭头随路网缩放。 - 加入常驻交通标志面板、EU／US 样式和实时位置／旋转调整；滚轮仅修改悬浮输入框，并使用选定步长。 - 修正辅助牌材质与本地化文字，比较禁止对象和除外对象，合并为一块辅助牌、最多两行；整类其它车辆允许时正确显示“其它车辆除外”。 - 沿用既有城市存档禁行数据，正式版不引入新的存档格式或迁移。
